Practical lab description: Multi-panel log analyser: LLM app prompt and retrieval logs, tool-call audit log, SaaS connector audit, proxy log and a response console. Learner traces an indirect injection planted in a shared document to the connector that exported files, scopes affected users and orders the response. Flag CBX{revoke_plugin} proves the abused connector and response order.
Scenario/evidence & flag theme: Tools/evidence: prompt/retrieval logs, tool-call audit, connector audit and proxy logs with benign decoys. Flag proves the abused connector was identified and revoked (CBX{revoke_plugin}).
